item.title: Kymara 1.0.0-beta.6
item.description:
New

  • FreeDV RADE digital voice (receive). A new RADE mode (⌘8) decodes FreeDV's Radio Autoencoder (RADE V1) signals. The sideband follows the usual convention automatically (LSB below 10 MHz except 60 m, USB above) or can be set by hand. The sidebar shows the decoder state (sync, SNR, frequency offset), the VFO bar shows a RADE badge while in sync, and the sender's callsign is decoded from the end-of-over frame.

Improvements

  • The passband is no longer tinted in the waterfall, so weak signals inside it are as easy to see as anywhere else. Its edges are still marked, and the spectrum keeps its tint.
  • Audio keeps playing when the output device changes (headphones, AirPlay, another device in Sound settings) while the radio is running.
  • The app now includes the license texts of all bundled libraries (librtlsdr, libusb, Sparkle, RADE, Opus).

item.title: Kymara 1.0.0-beta.5
item.description:
DX cluster

Kymara can now show live amateur radio spots from DXHeat.com. It is off by default: turn it on in the new DX Spots tab, under View → DX Cluster, or in Settings.

  • Spot list in a tab beside Favourites (View → Show DX Spots, ⌥⌘X): callsign, flag, UTC time, frequency, mode, continent and comment, with a coloured stripe for CW, phone or digital. Click a spot, or move through the list with the arrow keys, to tune to it in its mode. Right-click to add a spot to your favourites, copy the callsign or look it up on DXHeat.
  • Labels on the spectrum for the spots in view, coloured by mode and fading with age (View → Show DX Spot Labels, ⇧⌘L). Click a label to tune to it. With Differentiate Without Color on in the system settings, labels also name the mode.
  • Filters by range (all spots, tuner range or visible span), mode, DX continent and text. They apply to both the list and the labels.
  • Modes: CW as reported; digital modes such as FT8 and RTTY in USB, including spots on the standard FT8/FT4 frequencies; SSB as reported or by the usual sideband convention.
  • Kymara checks for new spots every minute (adjustable in Settings) and only while its window is visible. The status bar shows the number of spots or why they are not updating.

Other changes

  • Recalling a favourite or tuning to a spot no longer re-centres a zoomed view when the frequency is already in view.
  • The frequency under the cursor is now shown at the top of the waterfall, also when hovering over the spectrum; the readout on the spectrum itself is gone.
  • In the favourites list, the selected row is the favourite you are tuned to, and the arrow keys move between favourites.
  • The toolbar button that shows favourites is now called Side Panel, as it also holds the DX spots. View → Show Favourites (⌥⌘B) opens it on the Favourites tab.

item.title: Kymara 1.0.0-beta.4
item.description:
Changes

  • Waterfall auto range now sets the levels from the waterfall lines as they are actually drawn, not from the averaged spectrum. The noise floor stays dark and strong stations no longer saturate.
  • Smoother sidebar: live readouts (RDS, SNR, squelch, stereo pilot) no longer redraw the whole sidebar and window several times a second, so scrolling the sidebar while listening no longer stutters.
  • License: Kymara is now licensed under GPL-3.0. The README lists the bundled libraries (librtlsdr, libusb, Sparkle) with their versions and licenses.

item.title: Kymara 1.0.0-beta.3
item.description:
What's new

Automatic updates

  • Kymara now updates itself. Use Kymara → Check for Updates…, or let it check automatically. Updates installed from within the app don't need approval in System Settings, so macOS only asks once, on the first install.
  • A new Updates section in Settings (⌘,) lets you turn automatic checks on or off and choose whether to include pre-releases (beta versions). Pre-releases are off by default.

Coming from 1.0.0-beta.2 or earlier? Those versions have no updater, so install this one by hand. If you want to keep receiving beta versions, turn on Include pre-releases in Settings afterwards.
